Data Usage Terms

This page explains the terms for using training-related data published on Shiba Muscle. Please review these terms before quoting, referencing, or sharing the data.

Last updated: July 10, 2026

Covered data

These terms apply to exercise-level average weights, average reps, strength standards, and exercise metadata such as primary muscles and categories published on Shiba Muscle.

Page copy, images, design, and app-related materials are covered by the site's copyright and general terms of use.

Allowed uses

  • Referencing the data for personal training plans, learning, or comparison
  • Quoting short excerpts or summaries with a link to Shiba Muscle
  • Introducing individual pages in articles, social posts, or documents with clear source credit

Conditions

  • Credit "Shiba Muscle" and include the URL of the relevant page.
  • Do not misrepresent context such as update date, unit, exercise, sex, bodyweight, or age.
  • Do not imply that Shiba Muscle endorses or approves a third-party service, product, or claim.

Prohibited uses

  • Modifying, reposting, or redistributing data in a misleading way
  • Copying all or a substantial part of the Shiba Muscle database as a replacement service or redistributable dataset
  • Automated collection, scraping, or crawling that places heavy load on the server
  • Using the data for illegal, dangerous, or malicious purposes

Disclaimer and contact

Shiba Muscle data is reference information for general fitness use. We do not guarantee accuracy, completeness, or fitness for a particular purpose.

If you have questions about data use or are considering large-scale use, please contact us through the contact page.
